annotation_policy: All 25 question wordings and answerability labels were approved by the project owner on 2026-11-16. Answerable evidence references are mapped to existing corpus passages; unanswerable questions intentionally have no gold evidence IDs. Approval does not claim independently measured retrieval or answer quality.

splits.validation: Used only to select an abstention threshold for the 100/20 application configuration (C01-C08).
splits.test: Held out for retrieval and answer evaluation; never used for threshold selection (T01-T17).

questions.question: Which measurement units can a fixed-size chunker use to decide how much text to place in a chunk?

questions.question: Which kinds of document cues may guide the boundaries chosen by semantic chunking?

questions.review_status: human-reviewed; approved by project owner on 2026-11-16

questions.question: Why might a fixed cosine-similarity cutoff behave differently across search questions or collections?
questions.reference_answer: Cosine similarity is not a calibrated relevance probability, and a fixed cutoff can vary in behavior across queries and corpora.
questions.rationale: The cited dense-retrieval passage states that similarity cutoffs vary and are not calibrated probabilities.
questions.review_status: human-reviewed; approved by project owner on 2026-11-16

questions.question: How does BM25 change the contribution of repeated occurrences of a query term?
questions.reference_answer: Repetition can increase a passage's score, but each additional occurrence contributes less than the previous one.
questions.rationale: The cited passage defines term-frequency saturation and diminishing additional contribution.
questions.review_status: human-reviewed; approved by project owner on 2026-11-16

questions.question: Why can RRF combine dense and BM25 rankings without first normalizing their raw score scales?
questions.reference_answer: RRF combines positions in ranked lists rather than the retrievers' original score magnitudes.
questions.rationale: The cited passage explains that RRF fuses rank positions rather than raw score magnitudes.
